in_marathi.name: Dheerendra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dheerendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dheerendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dheera’ meaning fearless and ‘andra’ meaning man. This name is bestowed upon a child to instill courage and bravery in them. Dheerendra is a revered name in Hindu mythology, where it is believed to have been borne by several gods and rulers.
